review_type: read-only pre-run harness audit, not post-PR fresh review

checks.name: formal profile and identity
checks.evidence: 600s unless explicit smoke; clean commit/revision/SHA required in formal mode; Linux arm64 cgroup-v2 and pinned fixture images verified; DefaultConfig with only two backend routes. 1GiB/2CPU/96PID/read-only nonroot CLI launch is enforced by memoryRecoveryCLI lines147-158.

checks.name: fixed arrival and total
checks.evidence: 30s warmup then600s measurement; absolute 5ms schedule yields126000 steady-pattern RPCs (6000warmup +120000measured). Two Stores split100RPC/s each; 50%Read/20%Put/15%Native/10%Lua/5%Batch4; driver inflight512 rejects visibly rather than shedding hidden offers.

checks.name: burst
checks.evidence: 256 additional jobs scheduled at measurement+300s, offered from one-second metrics tick; Read/Put/Native alternating Stores. Each RPC uses3s caller; burst distributions are logged but p99/max end-to-end gates apply only steady. No separate assertion proves exact tick start or burst flag at function end; actual burst offered=256 evidence should be checked externally.

checks.name: slow consumers
checks.evidence: 32 persistent goroutines share one retry-disabled grpc connection; use8MiB seeded native[3] requests split16/store; begin measurement+150s,120s phase,500ms callback delay; every stream must show continuous chunks (no observed >2s gap after3s startup) and >=232callbacks. Chunk bytes are counted/logged; slow-stream bodies are not independently decoded, while immutable8MiB source is included in final oracle.

checks.name: all call results and latency
checks.evidence: Every offered job result consumed; any RPC error/failure/incomplete/non-APPLIED fails immediately. Call context3s; e2e includes schedule lag. reportQualificationStats622-655 enforces per-Store steady p99 Read100ms Put/Native250ms Lua/Batch4 500ms plus max e2e3s. Warmup/burst distributions logged without percentile gates.

checks.name: independent full dataset oracle
checks.evidence: Read/Native verify full expected n/pad per response, mutations require APPLIED. Only successful results update expected unique write IDs or Lua counters. Final769-867 checks all Mongo records/IDs/n/pad and count; Search mget all expected IDs, duplicates/found/n/pad, refreshed _count exact. Decoders intentionally compare schema n/pad, not arbitrary extra fields.

checks.name: default resource policy and bounded ledger
checks.evidence: All26 execution metric families required finite/nonnegative; policy32768leases/1024native and trusted byte budget checked, state sum and ingress ownership conservation checked. Main test148-154 checks per-Store16active,1024pending,32MiB,128batch/4MiB/20ms. Main344-357 rejects any increased memory budget denial or Store bounds breach during one-second samples.

checks.name: final ownership recovery
checks.evidence: Client closes,20temporary execution ownership fields and all12Store/RPC output gauges must zero; config gauges retain values and rejection counter must unchanged. Latch0/working_set<=70% required. However idle is accepted before deadline check, so a scrape completing after5s may falsely satisfy the fixed5s gate.

checks.name: normal exit and no OOM
checks.evidence: Owned label confirmed before cleanup. docker stop --timeout8; stopped owned state must OOMKilled=false and ExitCode=0 or t.Error fails test. Removal and absence verified. Default restart policy absent, so OOM cannot be hidden by automatic restart.

findings.title: Reject final ownership success observed after the fixed5s deadline
findings.description: The function checks idle and breaks before checking time.Now().After(deadline). A last scrape can begin at4.9s, block up to2s (testmetrics.Scrape line56), return an idle sample at6s, and still pass the stated fixed5s recovery gate. This is an acceptance harness false pass, not a production runtime fault. Check deadline before accepting idle, as waitTypedMemoryIdle already does at typed_memory_budget_integration_test.go745-748. Do not increase the5s limit.

run_requirements: Unset WEIR_PRODUCTION_QUALIFICATION_SMOKE; successful Go exit alone does not distinguish a deliberately opted-in smoke run.
Run exact clean candidate and race host driver without concurrent build/backend workload.

Preserve first full stdout/stderr/exit, source and binary hashes; additionally assert qualification=true duration10m0s, exact6000warmup+120000steady+256burst distributions, slow_duration2m0s and32-stream completion/join log.
Sampled one-second gauges establish observed bounds, not absence of subsecond peaks; final process exit/OOM and conservation checks remain mandatory.
